name: wget-cloud-implementation
description: Architecture-safe multi-agent implementation and evidence-driven bugfix workflows for Wget Cloud repositories.

interface.shortDescription: Multi-agent delivery and evidence-driven bug fixes.
interface.longDescription: Coordinates planned implementation plus evidence-first bug diagnosis, reproduction, root-cause analysis, protected regression tests, independent architecture/review/QA, GitOps infrastructure changes, and approval-gated deployment across the Wget Cloud repositories.
defaultPrompt: Use $wgc-implementation to deliver a Wget Cloud feature through architecture, tests, review, QA, and GitOps gates.
Use $wgc-bugfix to reproduce, diagnose, fix, review, and verify a Wget Cloud defect.
